aggregation.description: How to count events towards the final result count.  When querying with a data source of "eo_commerce_event", the aggregation may also be specified as "revenue", in which case the counts returned are the sum of revenue from matching events, and not the number of events themselves.

data_source.description: A string value representing the data source.  See [Topics](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/branch-aggregate-api#topics) for complete list.

dimensions.description: An array representing dimension(s) to group by. Limit is 11. See [Dimensions](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/branch-aggregate-api#dimensions) for complete list.

enable_install_calculation.description: If true, then Branch will de-dupe unattributed installs caused by duplicate events from non-opt-in users coming from paid ads (result from [iOS 14.5 privacy changes](https://help.branch.io/faq/docs/ios-14-faqs)).

end_date.description: The end of the interval time range represented as an ISO-8601 complete date.

filters.description:
Keys are same as dimensions. Values are an array of values to match for the dimension.

An object defining filters to match or disallow certain values.

name.description: The name of the event, such as "CLICK", "INSTALL", "PURCHASE" or custom event names like "UpdateSettings". Set either by the client (e.g. custom events) or automatically server side. See [events](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/tracking-commerce-content-lifecycle-and-custom-events#available-events) for Standard Events enum.

origin.description: Whether the event originated with a Branch SDK/API call, or was sent by Segment or mParticle. Set automatically server side.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds for the event. Set automatically server side.

user_data_country.description: Country, derived from user agent string or request body field. Specified by the client.

user_data_environment.description: Runtime environment where the event occurred, which can distinguish between e.g. full app vs instant app. Specified by the client.

user_data_geo_country_code.description: Country code, derived from IP address. Set automatically server side.

user_data_geo_dma_code.description: DMA code, derived from IP address. https://support.google.com/richmedia/answer/2745487?hl=en. Set automatically server side.

user_data_geo_region_en.description: Human-readable region, derived from IP address. Set automatically server side.

user_data_language.description: Language specified in the user_agent string (or in some cases other headers), Specified by the client.

user_data_opted_in.description: Boolean for whether the second OPEN can be inferred as INSTALL after opt-in. If set, the event can be considered as our synthetic OPEN generated by api-open by inspecting incoming event parameters with persona data. If the event is not considered as the second OPEN, the flag is not present. Only available for iOS14.5 or higher

user_data_opted_in_status.description: Current authorization status of opt-in flag for iOS14.5 or higher traffic. The flag is sent directly from the SDK.

user_data_os.description: Operating System (OS) of the device where the event occurred. Note that robots include web and app robots for easy filtering. Specified by the client.

user_data_platform.description: Convenience dimension that allows users to easily see web vs app, desktop vs mobile, and iOS vs Android vs other. Derived from information specified by the client.

granularity.description: The time granularity that each band value will represent.

start_date.description: The start of the interval time range represented as an ISO-8601 complete date.
